title: Coarse foliations — Question 12.2
exact_target: Does every hyperbolic three-manifold admit a recurrent cone field with only noncontractible supported loops, and how broadly can tautness survive surgery on a supported loop?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 10300052 (AMR-102-0052). CC BY 4.0.
Danny Calegari, \emph{Problems in foliations and laminations of 3-manifolds}, version 0.78 (2002), Question 12.2; Definitions 1.1--1.10 and local definitions and Remark (2).

Danny Calegari, \emph{Useful branched surfaces which carry nothing}, version 0.82, arXiv:math/0010146v1 (2000), Definition 2.4, pp. 5--6 (withdrawn preprint, cited here for its cone-field terminology).
